ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Physical attack costing 1 stage.
Allies cannot make actions nor have damage redirected to them this combat. [Trait:Saiyan]: All of your opponent's Allies lose 3 stages, to a minimum of 0.

(Banish after use.)
